A trimmed copy of Epoch AI's Benchmarking Hub data (benchmark_data.zip,
downloaded 2026-10-14), for the tests of phase 21's report:
Data: Epoch AI, CC BY 4.0 (https://epoch.ai/benchmarks).
Only the rows of the model versions named in eval_tasks/reports/step-checkpoints.json,
from GPQA diamond, OTIS Mock AIME 2024-2025, MATH level 5, SimpleQA Verified and
Humanity's Last Exam (Epoch's collection from other sources, which keep their Source column),
with the benchmark and model rows they need. Every value is theirs, as downloaded.
